propositions: After RP-02 S2 T2 moved absence/tombstone/comment operations into binding_lifecycle.py, the idempotency test's clock patch on binding_store_mod._now_iso no longer reaches clear_absent and sibling functions that now resolve _now_iso from binding_lifecycle module

The integration test still passes and correctly asserts no-churn on unchanged passes, but its ability to catch regressions where clear_absent stamps updated_at unconditionally is weakened because the patch does not intercept the moved operations' clock calls

The unit-tier test test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence already pins the no-stamp contract on binding_lifecycle, so risk is contained but integration-tier oracle blast radius was silently narrowed

clear_absent is structurally unreachable on healthy in-window passes because both call sites require out-of-window-but-alive keys, making mutation-RED verification of unconditional-stamp behavior infeasible at the integration level without harness extensions
